title: Norwegian Fish Pudding
description: A sour and glassy-jelly Norwegian dish featuring lime leaves, perfect for meal prep, high in protein and friendly to various diets. This pudding is made with fish, cream, and lime leaves, making it a unique and delicious option.
instructions: Rinse the cod fish and cut it into small pieces.
In a large saucepan, combine the fish, heavy cream, lime leaves, lemon juice, gelatin, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the mixture over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the gelatin has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it steep for 10 minutes.
Strain the mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean bowl, discarding the solids.
Whisk the mixture until it is smooth and emulsified.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate the pudding until it is set, at least 3 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, melt the butter and pour it over the top of the pudding.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with additional lime leaves if desired.
